action: I open my eyes slowly, letting them adjust, and take a careful look around at where I've landed before moving.
I crouch to look closer at the chalk mark on the slate beside me -- a circle with a line through it, freshly drawn. I want to understand what it means before I commit to a street.
I straighten up, stop lingering, and walk toward the queue-street -- if a debt called me here, that shuttered door is where I settle it. I fall in at the back of the line.
'First visit,' I say back, keeping my voice low. 'What is behind that door, and what is it going to cost me to find out?'
Decline the paid introduction; ask Myria who runs the queue and how to find the person I owe a debt to.
